Battery problem on my Nimbus 14

Hi support,

My Nimbus 14 is not working right. The battery goes down by about 30% when the computer is closed at night but it is fine during the day. I do not know what to do. Can you help me?
reference_answer: This is a known issue with Nimbus 14 BIOS version 1.08, which stops the laptop from entering its deepest sleep state. Update the BIOS to version 1.10 in Quillfen Update Utility > BIOS, with the charger connected and the lid open. Until you update, use Hibernate instead of Sleep. Your battery health is not affected, so no warranty claim is needed.
